subject: Kickoff: Pilot success plan & 45-day close playbook (draft share)
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@lumon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Pilot success plan & 45-day close playbook (draft share)

Samantha — thanks for taking time today. Per our call, attaching a starter MAP and a concise 45-day playbook so your team can see a concrete path to value and a proposed close timeline. The goal of the first workshop is to align success metrics, owners, and the minimal technical validation we need to unblock procurement.

Quick notes:
- Attached: LUMON_MAP_v1.gdoc (editable seed) + 45day_playbook_Lumon.slides (two-slide summary).
- Proposed workshop: Wed, Dec 2, 10:00–11:00 PT — working session to fill owner names and acceptance criteria.
- Critical milestones: sandbox access (week 1), perf smoke tests (week 2), security questionnaire answers (week 2–3), procurement sign-off (target day 45).

Ask: can you share the primary stakeholders who should join (engineering, security, procurement)? If procurement needs a specific intake form or PO cadence, include a contact. We’ll iterate the doc based on your feedback and be prepared with a trimmed demo for the workshop.

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Marissa (customer success) and Alex (solutions eng) who will co-run the workshop.

--
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@lumon.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumon.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Pilot success plan & 45-day close playbook (draft share)

Thanks, Nikhil — appreciated the clear artifacts. This looks useful. A few quick items from our side:

- Stakeholders: myself (product), Dan Torres (eng lead, dan.torres@lumon.ai), Priya Rao (security, priya.rao@lumon.ai), and procurement (procurement@lumon.ai).
- Procurement note: we require a short vendor questionnaire and our standard MSA review. Procurement estimates ~3 weeks for review once we have redlines.
- Workshop: Dec 2 at 10:00 PT works for product + engineering (we'll confirm security after internal check).

Could you include a short acceptance checklist (3–5 criteria) in the MAP that we can sign off on? Also please add a row for data residency/retention (we host in us-west, but want to confirm logs retention policy).

I'll attach a quick PDF with procurement timings and the procurement contact.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Pilot success plan & 45-day close playbook (draft share)

Looping in a few quick edit suggestions before the workshop — I'll do a pass on the MAP tonight and add accept/reject criteria for each milestone. High level thoughts:

1) Success metrics — keep to three measurable outcomes: latency P95 under 350ms for the 2k token path, classification F1 > 0.88 on the verification set, and <20% cost increase vs current baseline for first month. Put these in the "Acceptance" column so procurement and product can sign off easily.

2) Security row — add SOC 2 Type II status + an item "audit log retention: 90 days default, option to extend" with owner = Redwood Security (we'll fill exact contact).

3) Sandbox access — include a one-page test plan for the perf smoke so Dan's team can run it during week 1 (tools, endpoints, token budgets).

I'll update LUMON_MAP_v1.gdoc with comments and create a short checklist section called "Procurement artifacts" that lists the MSA + vendor questionnaire + SOC evidence.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@lumon.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP seed + short demo plan

Samantha — I made a lightweight pass on the MAP and uploaded a new version. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcd-Lumon-MAP-v1 (edit access for your team). Changes are small and focused:

- Added the 3 acceptance criteria Marissa suggested (latency, F1, cost).
- Inserted a 1-page perf smoke test in the sandbox section (tools + curl examples).
- Added a "Who signs" column to make procurement handoff explicit.

Also attached a 2-slide demo outline we can run in 10–12 minutes during the workshop so engineering can see the minimal validation. We'll hold deeper demos for week 2.

If procurement needs the doc in PDF for internal review I can export and send — Nikhil, do you want me to push a PDF to procurement@lumon.ai now?

Thanks all — I reviewed the updated doc and it aligns with what Product and Eng need. Workshop confirmed for Dec 2, 10:00 PT (I'll send calendar invites for Dan + product).

Procurement asked that you send a PDF copy of the MAP + our vendor questionnaire answers to procurement@lumon.ai so they can start the MSA review in parallel. Procurement will triage and provide an estimate; current internal expectation is ~3 weeks after they receive redlines. I attached our procurement timeline PDF and a short note with the intake contact (Sofia, sofia@lumon.ai).

Final ask before the workshop: can you add a single-line cell in the MAP that states "data residency: us-west; logs retention default: 90d" and an owner email for the SOC evidence? That will speed procurement.

See you on Dec 2.
